name: Jump rope
description: Bounce lightly on the balls of your feet, turning the rope with your wrists.

name: Brisk walk
description: Walk at a pace that raises your breathing but still lets you talk.

name: Bike sprint intervals
description: Pedal hard for a short burst, then recover slowly before the next sprint.
caution: Build up gradually. Stop if you feel chest pain, dizziness, or unusual breathlessness.

name: Steady rowing
description: Row at a comfortable, even pace, driving with your legs and then pulling with your back and arms.

name: Stair climb
description: Climb stairs at a steady pace, using the handrail only for balance.

name: High knees
description: Run in place, driving each knee up toward hip height.

name: Shadow boxing
description: Throw punches in the air with light footwork and steady breathing.

name: Jumping jacks
description: Jump while spreading your legs and raising your arms overhead, then return to start.

name: Easy cycling
description: Ride at a relaxed pace that keeps you warm and breathing comfortably.

name: Elliptical intervals
description: Alternate short fast efforts with easy strides on the elliptical.
